considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its low- and high-gradient outcomes establish a strong, smooth gradient effect and an open-branch contribution.
All provided rows share H and x_now, with no trajectory evidence implicating memory dynamics; the archive's ODE candidate also requires more trajectory rows.
It is a plausible alternative, but the simpler sourced two-layer siphon with a square-root open-branch term directly matches the observed strong gradient modulation and branch contrast.
The observations are structured and smooth, not high-frequency chaotic or nonstationary; prior failures do not establish that all stationary mechanisms fail.
